entries.note: DOI -> Van Baelen 2009 AAC (PMID 19223634); quote verbatim in abstract (Europe PMC full text returned 500). Non-member bevirimat opens the strip as proxy, scores nothing: allowed by evidence rule 6.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (dating: earliest public comparison) + engagement definition (viral load is listed as a proximal readout)
entries.note: Dicker 2019 (PMC6797179) quote verbatim. But the panel's own PD readout, viral replication, moved in dosed patients in Hwang 2017 (>=1 log10 at >=40 mg): first 'same' should be 2017, readout_tier proximal; keep 2019 resistance entry as strengthening.

Dicker 2022 AAC (PMC8765437, epub 2021-11-15) quote verbatim; Spinner 2022 confirms A364V in 4/6 at 200 mg, fold change 132; NCT03784079 results posted 2021-02-16. readout_tier 'direct' for binding-site resistance is a rule question.
Nowicka-Sans 2016 (PMC4914680) quote verbatim ('EC 50' spacing only). Serum shift 5.4x / 86% bound confirmed in full text; untested opening entry is correct.

Hwang 2017 CID (PMC5848258) quote verbatim; plateau >=500 vs 643 ng/mL target is within 2x and the paper states the comparison. Phase 2b caveat (flat exposure-response, M184V backbone failures, Morales-Ramirez 2018) verified; see rule question 3.

Spinner 2022 (PMC9536290) quote verbatim; target = 3x PBA EC90 of R361K/V362I/L363M triple polymorph = 150 nM (110 ng/mL), PK non-proportional 140-200 mg, so direction_only is right. NCT03784079 results 2021-02-16 confirmed.

Same Van Baelen 2009 source/quote as engagement 1. Status fine, but the judgement's 'no animal efficacy model exists for this class' is wrong: bevirimat was efficacious in HIV-1-infected SCID-hu Thy/Liv mice (Stoddart 2007), cited by Nowicka-Sans 2016 ref 52. See missing.

Hwang 2017 quotes verbatim ('log 10' spacing only); registry primary = day-11 HIV RNA change; NCT01803074 results 2019-11-25, NCT02415595 2018-09-19 and its 76-83% vs 77% quote verified. Patient-level V362I/V370A reduced-response finding (Dicker 2022) could be its own prediction_level=patient entry.

Joshi 2025 DOMINO (PMC12675029, epub 2025-10-17) and DYNAMIC (PMC12675015) quotes verbatim; NCT04493216 results 2023-11-18, NCT04900038 2023-12-14; whyStopped = company portfolio decision, 'not based on any safety or efficacy concerns'. model_src Dicker 2022 resolves (PBA EC90 33 nM, isolates EC50 9 nM confirmed).

Johnson 2018 (PMC5989765) quote verbatim. Draft omits that two CV findings (troponin rise, NSVT) in Study 200207 caused an FDA clinical hold, lifted after 6-month rat and 9-month dog studies; so species ARE public and the model text 'species not public' is wrong. 'same' still holds.

Joshi 2025 quote verbatim; EGD sub-study rationale ('translation of non-clinical toxicology findings (eg, parietal cell and chief cell changes)') and unchanged gastrin/pepsinogen I/II confirmed. contra/opposite follows the v3 safety rule, but rests on 14 on-drug biopsies at 24 weeks with no public margin: see rule question 2.

Stoddart 2007 PLoS One (PMC2080775) quote verbatim in abstract and text. Non-member bevirimat proxy opener, product_in_model false, scores nothing: decision 7 (#112). CA-SP1 cleavage in infected thymocytes is a direct readout. No member found in this model.

Quote verbatim; full text confirms plasma >2 ug/ml for 6 h after 100 mg/kg and 'achievable in humans after oral dosing'. Exposure statement is bevirimat-only, no member target: untested proxy opener under decision 7.

Quote verbatim ('log(10)' in abstract, 'log 10' in text); >2 log10 at 100 mg/kg per day and SP1/A1V in-vivo resistance confirmed. Untested proxy opener (decision 7, #112); withdrawing the draft's 'no animal model' claim is right.

Hwang 2017 (PMC5848258) quote verbatim (Fig 8). Untested opener right. Caveat: Hwang is a 3-parameter sigmoid Emax fit to observed C24, no popPK/NONMEM/trial simulation, and no source says 60/120/180 mg came from the plateau; model text overstates this arm.

Morales-Ramirez 2018 (PMC6198970) quote verbatim. Week-24 primary met at all doses with flat exposure-response as the plateau implied: decision 4 case 2, direction_only. Drafter-made pairing; the paper credits the PoC study, not the Emax plateau. Year = registry 2018-09-19.

DYNAMIC (PMC12675015) quote verbatim; popPK/exposure-response trial simulation chose the doses, >=100 mg predicted >75% max effect, 100/150 but not 200 mg cleared the prespecified threshold. Troughs reached: decision 4 case 2; 'partial' honest. Spinner 2022 EC50 ~170 ng/mL checked.

Stamatopoulos 2023 (PMC9965536) quote verbatim. Model developed, qualified and verified on the FTIH (NCT03231943), Phase 2a, food-effect (NCT04263142) and ADME data it reproduces: retrodiction, so retro never same (decision 10). Observed/predicted within 2-fold confirmed.

Johnson 2018 (PMC5989765) quote verbatim (Introduction); 'preclinical evaluation indicated negligible renal excretion' and the PA-IC90 threshold confirmed. Prospective regimen prediction (CYP3A4 clearance -> RTV boosting) counts under decision 4 (#91); qualitative, low confidence. Rule question 4 stays open.

Wen 2022 DMD (PMID 36153007) quote verbatim in abstract; full text paywalled. The comparison sentence is 'all consistent with low in vitro intrinsic clearance in liver microsomes and hepatocytes'; prefer it as the quote. Strengthening same; rule question 4 caveat.

missing: Humanized mouse efficacy model, no track: HIV-1-infected SCID-hu Thy/Liv mice, oral bevirimat cut viral RNA >2 log10 at plasma concentrations 'achievable in humans' with dose-dependent CA-SP1 cleavage inhibition in thymocytes and in-vivo confirmation of the SP1/A1V resistance phenotype (Stoddart 2007, PLoS One, doi 10.1371/journal.pone.0001251, PMID 18043758; cited as ref 52 in Nowicka-Sans 2016). No member was reported in it, so it is a separate track opening 'untested' (proxy, product_in_model false), and the draft's claim that no animal efficacy model exists must be withdrawn.

Chronic animal toxicology as the track's species: Johnson 2018 (doi 10.1002/prp2.408) names 6-month rat and 9-month dog studies for GSK2838232 and an FDA clinical hold (Studies 200912/200207 terminated; resumed as Study 204953) that the draft's safety track does not record; not a new track but a dated event on mi-nonclinical-tox.

Candidate, pending rule question 4: cross-species ADME/PK prediction compared with human PK for GSK2838232 (oral bioavailability 6-40% across species, preclinical metabolite profile 'qualitatively similar' to human plasma, negligible renal excretion predicted and used to skip urine collection), Johnson 2018 doi 10.1002/prp2.408; the GSK3640254 discovery paper (Regueiro-Ren 2022, J Med Chem, doi 10.1021/acs.jmedchem.2c00879, abstract only) describes the preclinical PK profile that preceded the Phase 1 (Pene Dumitrescu 2020, doi 10.1002/prp2.671).
rule_questions: readout_tier for on-treatment resistance selection at the drug's binding site (A364V at CA/SP1): 'direct', 'proximal', or not an engagement readout at all when the model's own PD readout (viral replication = viral load, listed as proximal) is available earlier?

Safety 'contra' for a predicted animal harm absent in patients: what minimum sample size and duration makes 'never appeared' a comparison rather than 'untested' (here 14 on-drug paired gastric biopsies at 24 weeks, planned Week-96 biopsies never done), and does an animal finding with no public exposure margin count as a stated prediction of harm at clinical exposure (decision 16 interaction)?

Dose table: when the exposure target was reached and the Week-24 primary was met but the regimen was abandoned for emergent NRTI-backbone resistance and GI intolerability (GSK3532795 Phase 2b, NCT02415595), does the 'reached, failed, abandoned' row apply, or does dose stay 'same' because efficacy is judged on the primary endpoint only?

Does a cross-species ADME/PK projection (bioavailability, metabolite profile, excretion route) compared with human PK count as a model-system track, or is only the exposure-target model (serum-shifted EC90) scored under dose?

Patient-level prediction on an existing track (baseline Gag V362I/V370A predicted and observed reduced response): does it require its own entry with prediction_level 'patient', or is one entry per status change per track regardless of prediction_level?

May a track that only a non-member first-generation drug (bevirimat) ever used in vivo (SCID-hu Thy/Liv mice) appear as an 'untested' track opened by proxy, or does a track need at least one member run in it to exist?
